text:
Alex: heads-up: after yesterday's autokernel rollout I'm seeing a 12-18% p99 latency regression on Llama-3-13b for our chattemplate workloads. profile attached below, looks like KV cache churn + unexpected kernel switch during prefix steps. pinging @Maria and @Kai for quick triage.

Maria: thanks Alex. can you paste the perf markers? I pulled a trace and the hot path is in selector.cpp:chooseKernel() -> fallback_path() around the 2nd kv refill. flamegraph shows a lot of time in kv_evict() calls.

Alex: gist of trace (sanitized):
```
# trace snippet
0.00 - accept_request()
0.02 - selector::chooseKernel(arch=llama3, seq=512, heads=32, hsize=4096)
0.03 - kernel_switch(warm->fallback)
0.04 - kv_refill()
0.09 - kv_evict()
0.12 - partial_kv_resync()
```
Seeing kernel_switch at early prefix boundaries even though throughput is low. suspect rope_theta handling + head_dim mismatch causes selector to prefer fallback fused kernels that do extra copies.

Kai: hmm. we changed the heuristic to prefer fused L2L3 kernels for >12 heads if RMSNorm present. Llama-3-13b has 32 heads and SiLU-enabled layernorm path in the model config, but our kernel compatibility table for the quantized variant is incomplete. If selector overestimates kernel cost for the primary path it will route to fallback with more KV copies.

Maria: confirmed. my microbench shows primary kernel has ~0.8x memory copies vs fallback's 1.7x on 13b when head_dim % 64 != 0 and rope_theta != default. That multiplies when chat template has long system messages (prefix ~640 tokens) causing repeated kv writes.

Jamal: can the chattemplate be part of the regression? we've recently changed default templates to include expanded system role and a long safety checklist, so average prefix len jumped from ~120 to ~430 for a subset of routes. KV cache pressure + head alignment problems = thrash.

perf-bot: [regression-alert] Model: llama-3-13b, Route: /chat, Delta p99 +15.2% last_rollout: autokernel-v2.3. See job 2024-11-18T09:12Z for traces. :rotating_light:

Alex: proposal: two quick steps to validate hypothesis:
1) force selector to prefer primary kernel for a single rollout (AB test) by overriding is_fused_preferred=false for model=llama3-13b on any >16-head config.
2) add a chattemplate-aware batching guard that reduces batching window for routes with prefix>256 tokens so we don't amplify KV churn.

Kai: I can push a selector toggle. small patch:
```
--- a/runtime/selector/config.yaml
+++ b/runtime/selector/config.yaml
@@
 - model: llama3-13b
   selectors:
-    - fused_pref: auto
+    - fused_pref: false  # temp AB: force primary kernel to avoid fallback copy path
```
I'll also add telemetry tags so we can correlate kernel choice with p99.

Maria: I'll run microbench with varying rope_theta values. early note: rope_theta default drift (we recently changed from 10000->8192 for a couple models) changes frequency alignment and seems to expose head_dim misalignment (head_dim 128 vs 122) which causes suboptimal vectorized kernels to be rejected. If rope_theta scaling changes attention interpolation slightly, that can change key/value sparsity patterns and cache locality.

Jamal: for the chattemplate guard I recommend: route metadata should include prefix_token_count and handler should set batching_window = min(default, prefix <= 256 ? default : 8ms). Will open a small RFC in devex. We should keep default unchanged for short contexts.

Alex: action items summarized:
- Kai: roll selector toggle to canary and attach kernel_choice telemetry (ETA 1h)
- Maria: run microbench matrix (rope_theta variants x head_dim alignment) and post numbers (ETA 4h)
- Jamal: prototype chattemplate batching guard and list routes impacted (ETA EOD)
- Ops: hold autokernel-v2.3 full rollout until canary completes :thumbsup:

Maria: quick battery of numbers I ran (local GPU A100):
```
config | p99(ms) | kv_evicts/sec
primary (fused_pref=true) | 210 | 73
forced_primary (fused_pref=false) | 185 | 21
primary+rope=8192 | 198 | 45
```
small but consistent improvement if we avoid fused fallback.

Kai: rolling canary now on 5% capacity. tagged with telemetry: kernel_choice=fallback|primary, prefix_len, route. will watch p50/p95/p99 and kv_evict_rate.

Alex: thanks — please drop traces here. also ping EngSRE if we need to rollback.

Jamal: adding note: for long-term fix we should update kernel compatibility logic to consider head_dim alignment (mod64) and rope_theta-sensitive thresholds rather than hard head-count cutoffs. I'll add to backlog with priority P1.

perf-bot: [canary-start] autokernel-v2.3 canary @5% started by Kai at 1748552520. Monitoring kernel_choice and kv_evict_rate.

Alex: nice, that's enough to triage for now. if canary shows reversion in p99 we'll ship a global override until proper compatibility matrix is updated. :eyes:
